newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains higher on thin market.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains higher on thin market.

text.p: UK cash grain were higher on Friday, but players were not keen to follow the firm futures market too closely.
"There isn't much confidence in the rise on the futures market owing to the thinness of participation," said one broker.
Higher U.S. markets which rose on weather concerns and news that the European Commission had stopped its weekly grain tender were behind the rise.
Cash prices were 0.50 to one stg higher with trading reported on the fob market at 101 stg for June feed wheat and 103.50 stg for Jan/Mar ex-east coast ports.
Delivered market feed wheat traded at 100 and 100.50 stg for Apr and 105 and 105.50 stg for Jul.
Barley in the Southampton area fetched 105 stg for Apr. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
